image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs. The crabs are bright red/orange, indicating they have been boiled or steamed. They are stacked on top of each other, creating a chaotic arrangement of shells, legs, and claws. Some white meat is visible where shells are broken or joints are exposed. The lighting is somewhat diffuse, highlighting the glossy texture of the wet exoskeletons.
